name: aspect-ratio
behavior: None — layout primitive; no APG pattern (presentational wrapper, never focusable, adds no role; the hosted content keeps its own semantics)

parts.note: constrains the box to a caller-supplied ratio and stretches its single child to fill; carries no colour, type or spacing recipe of its own

anatomyNotes: The ratio is a continuous PROP (16/9, 4/3, 1), not a variant axis — axes are closed value sets (contract/variants.md). Salt has no equivalent; ratio-constrained media there is composed from layout primitives, so this anatomy is shadcn-only and deliberately token-free: a component that consumes no contract slot is legal when it contributes geometry alone.
